title: Set a system performance tuning profile
summary: Apply a specific performance tuning profile to your Linux system. This changes how the system manages CPU, disk, and other resources to optimize for different use cases.

steps.explain: Apply the specified performance tuning profile. Common profiles include 'balanced', 'powersave', and 'throughput-performance'.

placeholders.name: PROFILE_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the tuning profile to apply

rollback.explain: Disable tuning to revert to default system behavior.

warnings: Changing the tuning profile affects system resource management and may impact performance or power consumption.
